criteria.statement: report --format csv starts with the header line region,total

check.command: node --input-type=module -e 'import assert from "node:assert/strict"; import { spawnSync } from "node:child_process"; const r = spawnSync(process.execPath, ["bin/report.js", "--format", "csv"], { encoding: "utf8" }); assert.equal(r.status, 0, r.stderr); const lines = r.stdout.trimEnd().split("\n"); assert.equal(lines[0], "region,total");'

criteria.statement: One CSV row per region, totals with two decimals

check.command: node --input-type=module -e 'import assert from "node:assert/strict"; import { spawnSync } from "node:child_process"; const r = spawnSync(process.execPath, ["bin/report.js", "--format", "csv"], { encoding: "utf8" }); assert.equal(r.status, 0, r.stderr); const lines = r.stdout.trimEnd().split("\n"); assert.equal(lines.length, 5); assert.equal(lines[1], "North,120.50"); assert.equal(lines[4], "South,75.25");'

criteria.statement: Fields with commas or quotes are quoted, quotes doubled

check.command: node --input-type=module -e 'import assert from "node:assert/strict"; import { spawnSync } from "node:child_process"; const r = spawnSync(process.execPath, ["bin/report.js", "--format", "csv"], { encoding: "utf8" }); assert.equal(r.status, 0, r.stderr); const lines = r.stdout.trimEnd().split("\n"); assert.equal(lines[2], "\"North, East\",10.00"); assert.equal(lines[3], "\"Rivers \"\"Delta\"\"\",5.00");'
